title: pain i guess
description: a ridiculous progression mod for after you reach the end dimension!
body:
my aim for this mod is to make extremely difficult progression after the ender dragon to keep you entertained for hours after you have beaten the vanilla game!

this mod is designed to cause the player pain it is by no means a stable mod its unballanced and not in a good way, all i can give you for advice is good luck!
btw this mod will have horror elements!

i hope to update this regularly but i may be inconsistent.

features:
- 3 armour sets of increaceing power
- 2 new crafting blocks
- 5 new normal blocks with various uses
- 31 advancements to unlock
- a whole new dimention and biome
- a new liquid
- 2 foods
- many crafting recipes
- and some crafting ingredients
- and a verry dangerous effect
- tetanus
- more advancements
- fallout biome
- more crafting recipes
- new textures
- nukes

features coming soon:
- nuclear generators
